dialog_history.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you to the emergency department?
I’ve been having a cough that brings up colored or more sputum than usual, and I’ve noticed a wheezing sound when I exhale. With my COPD, this feels like a flare compared to my normal.
Are you experiencing any shortness of breath, and if so, is it worse than your usual baseline?
Yes, I’m short of breath, and it feels worse than my usual baseline. The wheezing is new for me like it’s more than normal.
Are you having any fever, chills, or night sweats?
No, I’m not having fever, chills, or night sweats.
Are you experiencing any chest pain or tightness?
No, I don’t have chest pain or tightness.
Have you noticed any new swelling in your legs or ankles, or do you find yourself waking up at night gasping for air?
No new swelling in my legs or ankles. I also haven’t been waking up at night gasping for air.
What color is the sputum you are coughing up
It’s colored—more than usual. I’m not sure of the exact color, but it looks different than my normal mucus.
Have you noticed any blood in the sputum you are coughing up?
No, I haven’t noticed any blood in the sputum.

Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you to the emergency department?

I’m having significant trouble breathing—like sudden episodes where I feel suffocated. Also, I can’t open or lift my eyelids well, my eyes don’t move the way I want, and I get annoying muscle spasms in my face and neck.
Can you tell me if you have recently had any cuts
No, I haven’t had any cuts.
Are you experiencing any difficulty swallowing, or
I’m not sure about swallowing—I don’t have trouble swallowing that I can say for sure. But the main problems are breathing episodes, eye/eyelid trouble, and muscle spasms in my face and neck.
Have you recently started any new medications, particularly antipsychotics or
Yes. I started or took an antipsychotic medication within the last 7 days.
Can you describe the muscle spasms in your face and neck
They’re annoying and kind of involuntary—my face and neck muscles twitch or tighten, and it feels hard to control. It comes in episodes.
Have you had any fever, sweating, or severe
I don’t think I’ve had fever or severe sweating. I can’t confirm severe sweating, but I don’t recall it being a big problem.
Do your eyes ever roll upwards or get stuck looking
Yes—my eyes don’t move normally and I can’t control the direction. Sometimes it feels like they get stuck in an abnormal position.

It’s mostly around my ear area—very localized there. I’d say the pain location feels like it’s at 10/10 for where it’s centered.

I haven’t noticed any specific hearing changes.

I’m 17. I haven’t noticed any rash, and I don’t think there’s redness or swelling on the outside of my ear.

No, I haven’t noticed any fluid or discharge coming out of my ear.
